race.description: Keagan Latham Champion Jockey Midway Mdn Plate
race.comment: HO ALOHA (4) recorded her sixth minor placing from 12 starts when a closing third over 1080m at the Canberra Acton track last start. That run followed a seven-week let-up so she should tighten up. Great chance to finally get the monkey off her back. LADY TALEA (5) has been just outside the placings at both runs this time in work, the latest over this course and distance last Saturday. Progressive filly who draws a much better gate this time. Peaking this afternoon. LUCSAIN (6) is a Zousain mare debuting as a five-year-old. All four siblings to race are winners. Trialling as though she has plenty of talent. FARCOLO (10) is back after an 18-week spell. Opened last prep with a handy third over this distance at Canberra then struggled in three stakes races. In the mix in this company. CHATAIGNE (9) returns for a second campaign. Placed at Warwick Farm on debut so she is capable of a big run while fresh.
